name: mscqr_staging_endpoint_readiness
scope: Preflight checklist for a real non-production MSCQR staging API endpoint before RLS validation.
forbiddenShortcuts: Do not point staging at production DB or production RDS Proxy.
Do not use the production ECS service as staging.
Do not use www.mscqr.com, mscqr.com, or default *.mscqr.com as staging.
Do not relax the collector guard for *.mscqr.com without a separate reviewed explicit allowlist.
Do not enable global or table-level RLS.
Do not commit real secret values.

checks.description: Staging endpoint is not mscqr.com, any *.mscqr.com host, or a host containing prod/production.
checks.evidence: Run node scripts/check-staging-endpoint-readiness.mjs --dry-run and collector host guard self-check.

checks.description: Staging uses a separate ECS service or task definition with staging-only environment values.
checks.evidence: Record staging cluster, service, and task definition names without secret values.

checks.description: Staging DATABASE_URL points to staging Postgres or sanitized snapshot restore, not production RDS or RDS Proxy.
checks.evidence: Record staging DB host name only.

checks.description: Staging Redis is separate or uses a formally reviewed isolated namespace with no production key overlap.
checks.evidence: Record staging Redis host or namespace, not credentials.

checks.description: Staging object storage uses a separate bucket or a strictly scoped staging prefix.
checks.evidence: Record staging bucket and prefix only.

checks.description: Staging JWT, QR signing, hash, token, and printer/session secrets are separate from production and stored only in secret stores.
checks.evidence: Record secret names or ARNs only, never values.

checks.description: GitHub staging vars no longer point at https://www.mscqr.com or https://www.mscqr.com/api.
Staging health endpoint returns healthy before collector baseline.
checks.evidence: curl -fsS against /api/health or the verified backend health route.

checks.description: All staged RLS route flags are false before baseline collection.
checks.evidence: Task definition env review and baseline collector summary.

checks.description: RLS collector dry-run and baseline with flags off complete against staging only.
checks.evidence: Safe collector summary without raw response bodies, IDs, tokens, cookies, or redirect locations.

recommendedOption: API-only staging backend reachable by a non-MSCQR ALB DNS name or explicitly reviewed internal hostname.
